description: Land Title Settlement Dept -T.R. Kesbewa, Kesbewa D/S/D, Colombo District (7859)
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively concerns land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It provides specific details for multiple parcels of land (e.g., parcel numbers, cadastral maps, village names, administrative divisions) and formally expunges particulars from previous gazette notices. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, which includes "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals." The content does not involve government personnel changes, portfolio assignments, or any of the other specialized non-land administrative matters.
